name: Reagan Crossing
summary: Reagan Crossing is a multi-phase retail development in Leander, Texas, developed by The Prime Developer to serve the rapidly growing northwest Austin community. Strategically located on Ronald Reagan Boulevard, this neighborhood shopping center provides convenient access to retail and services for local residents.
demographics: Reagan Crossing serves the rapidly growing Leander community in northwest Austin, attracting primarily young families and middle to upper-middle income households with median incomes ranging from $75,000 to $110,000. The trade area draws from Leander's expanding residential developments, appealing to homeowners aged 30-55 with children who prioritize convenience and value-oriented shopping. Typical visitors are suburban families seeking everyday retail and service needs in a convenient neighborhood setting, with shopping patterns focused on quick trips and essential purchases rather than destination shopping experiences.
description: Reagan Crossing is a multi-phase retail development located at 15101 Ronald Reagan Boulevard in Leander, Texas, strategically positioned to serve one of the fastest-growing communities in the Austin metropolitan area. Developed by The Prime Developer, this shopping center has been thoughtfully planned and executed in two distinct phases, demonstrating the developer's commitment to meeting the evolving retail needs of the expanding Leander market. The center benefits from its prime location along Ronald Reagan Boulevard, a major thoroughfare that provides excellent visibility and accessibility for the surrounding residential neighborhoods. As part of The Prime Developer's diverse portfolio of retail projects across Texas, Reagan Crossing reflects the company's expertise in creating community-oriented retail destinations that cater to local shopping preferences. The phased development approach has allowed the center to grow organically with the community, establishing itself as a convenient neighborhood shopping destination for Leander residents seeking quality retail and service options close to home.
